title: test(plugin-detail): gate RelatedList's client-mode sort-button case on the object schema (objectui#10895)
body:
Fixes #10895
Clause-②: no

Test-only. Branch `claude/issue-10895-relatedlist-client-sort-gate`, base objectui `origin/main` `733fd5ac6`, head `3abab7ce5`. Implemented for the PM claim `5865039628` in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.unmaterializedSort.test.tsx`, case "keeps that button in client mode": `renderList(…)` now returns into `const dataSource`, and after the existing `data-list` `waitFor` the case awaits `settleObjectSchema(dataSource)`, with the one-line reason: since objectui#10728 the sort-button row reads the masked stamp, which covers every column until the object schema lands (#7007). The existing `data-list` gate is kept, as the file's docblock asks (the two gates prove different facts).
- `.changeset/10895-plugin-detail-relatedlist-client-sort-gate.md`: empty frontmatter, releasing nothing. `check-changeset-presence` asked for it: it counts a test file under a released package's `src/` (verdict quoted under Gates).
- No source change, no retry, no raised timeout, no `waitFor` around the assertion.

**Mechanism, confirmed on this base.** The sort-button row skips every field that is not in `unmaskedColumnKeys`. While `objectTypesPending` holds (an `api`, a `getObjectSchema`, and no fields in hand), `tableColumns` stamps every column `masked`, so the key list is empty. In client mode (`data` passed) the rows and the `data-list` view exist on the first commit, before `getObjectSchema` resolves. So the case's only gate passed while the `Total` button could still be absent. On the auto-fetch path this window does not exist: the row fetch waits on the settled schema (objectui#10690), and the view mounts only after the rows land.

## Census

Every plugin-detail test that reaches `RelatedList` was read: 51 files name it, plus `DetailView.test.tsx` (retired `related:` entry, empty rows). `unmaskedColumnKeys` and `objectTypesPending` live in `RelatedList.tsx` only, within this package. Only a render that passes `data` together with an `api` and a data source carrying `getObjectSchema` has a window where the stamp still covers every column after the rows are in hand.

| File | Case(s) | Mode | Verdict | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RelatedList.unmaterializedSort` | "keeps that button in client mode" | client (`data` + `api` + `getObjectSchema`) | **needs the gate: gated here** | sort-button presence reads `unmaskedColumnKeys`; the only gate was the view type |
| `RelatedList.unmaterializedSort` | "offers no button for a formula field while windowed"; "withholds the header from a formula column while windowed" | windowed | gated already | `settleObjectSchema`, and the row fetch waits on the settled schema |
| `RelatedList.unmaterializedSort` | "leaves every stored column sortable — including the autonumber" | windowed | gated already (fetch chain) | the table mounts only after the rows, which wait on the settled schema |
| `RelatedList.unmaterializedSort` | "keeps the formula header live in client mode" | client | not schema-dependent | reads the column `sortable` flag; client mode never withholds it and the masked stamp does not touch it |
| `RelatedList.headerSort` | "keeps the button row for a `list` related list, which has no headers" | client, no `api` | not schema-dependent | with no `api` nothing is read, so `objectTypesPending` is false from the first render |
| `RelatedList.headerSort` | "keeps a relational header live in client mode" | client, no `api` | not schema-dependent | reads `sortable` |
| `RelatedList.headerSort` | the six windowed cases, and "renders no sort-button row for a table list" | windowed | gated already (fetch chain) / not schema-dependent | a `table` list never renders the button row |
| `RelatedList.sortabilitySignal` | surface 2, the five `data-list` sort-button cases | windowed | gated already (fetch chain) | `data-list` mounts only after the rows, which wait on the settled schema |
| `RelatedList.sortabilitySignal` | surface 1, the seven windowed header cases | windowed | gated already (fetch chain) | as above |
| `RelatedList.sortabilitySignal` | "leaves every header live in client mode" | client | not schema-dependent | reads `sortable` |
| `RelatedList.maskedFilterSort-10728` | filter box (five cases), `list` sort buttons (five cases), the table-header sort case | client | gated already | each waits on a fact only the landed schema produces (a drawn name, the `Name` sort button), or holds the schema on purpose (the two `held` cases) |
| `RelatedList.maskedFilterSort-10728` | the windowed `$orderby` case | windowed | gated already | waits for a drawn name |
| `RelatedList.maskedColumn-10657` | masked-header sort click, copy, tooltip, width, export | client | gated already | `settledWithMask` waits for a drawn name; the `held` and `rejected` cases read the withheld window on purpose, and it reads the same whether or not the read has settled |
| `RelatedList.maskedFirstPaint-10657` | held / rejected / settled | client | not in the class | reads cells, not a sort or filter control, through an explicit hold |
| `RelatedList.relationalSort` | "keeps it in client mode and orders by the resolved label, not the id" | client | gated already (implicitly) | it waits for the `sys_user` label read, which only the render holding the schema issues (the target comes from the schema's `reference`); the order assertion sits inside `waitFor` |
| `RelatedList.relationalSort` | the windowed case | windowed | gated already (fetch chain) | |
| `RelatedList.sortDroppedOutsideWindowed` | the filter-box cases | windowed, then client once a term is typed | not schema-dependent | its data source has no `getObjectSchema`, so `objectTypesPending` is false throughout |
| `RelatedList.serverpagination` | "keeps client-side slicing when the caller supplies data directly" | client, no data source | not schema-dependent | pagination only |
| `RelatedList.systemcolumns` | column order | auto-fetch | not in the class | column headers, not a sort or filter control; gated by the fetch chain |
| `RelatedList.columnIdentityAccessor.schema` | asserts `onSortChange` is a function | client | not schema-dependent | the callback exists whatever the stamp says |
| `columnHeaderLabel`, `columnIdentityAccessor`, `iconSeam-5935`, `parentscope`, `rowactions`, `userColumnNames-10112`, `DetailView.relatedEntryRetired-7997`, `RecordRelatedListRenderer.redactedDerivation-9053`, `RecordRelatedListRenderer.unresolvedIdentityFailClosed-8793`, `summaryChip.dateOnlyZone-10183` | their client-mode renders | client | not in the class | no sort button, filter box or sort call anywhere in the file; cell reads sit inside `waitFor` |
| every other file (the `RecordRelatedListRenderer.*` set and the remaining `RelatedList.*` files) | all | auto-fetch | no client window | `record:related_list` never passes `data`; the rows wait on the settled schema |

**Measured cross-check of the census.** A throwaway delay between `getObjectSchema` resolving and `useSettledSchema` settling (in `packages/react/src/hooks/useSettledSchema.ts`, which vitest aliases to source), run over all 51 files at base: at 50 ms, and again at 400 ms, `Tests  1 failed | 316 passed | 8 skipped (325)`, and the one failure is the target case. It was restored both times, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. That delay sits after the promise `settleObjectSchema` awaits, so it can find a race but cannot prove the gate. The green-after proof below uses the mock-level probe A.

## Proof (probe A: `getObjectSchema` delayed 50 ms in the file's throwaway mock, never committed)

Every leg ran through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 -> 0, blob moved, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty) under the verify lock.

- **Base `733fd5ac6`, no probe:** `Tests  5 passed (5)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Base, probe A: red, the CI signature.** `Tests  1 failed | 4 passed (5)`: `× keeps that button in client mode`, `TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an accessible element with the role "button" and name /Total/`, and the only buttons present were `Previous` and `Next`. The four other cases stayed green under the probe. `VERDICT command-exit 1`.
- **Head `b92ab92b3` (gate committed), probe A: green.** `Tests  5 passed (5)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Head, no probe (probe C):** three runs back to back, each `Tests  5 passed (5)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Gates (head `3abab7ce5` unless stated)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/` at `b92ab92b3`: `Test Files  216 passed | 1 skipped (217)`, `Tests  2120 passed | 8 skipped (2128)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The only later commit adds the `.changeset` file, which no plugin-detail test reads (`check-pending-changeset-literals`: `No test source names a pending changeset`). The changed file was re-run at `3abab7ce5`: `Tests  5 passed (5)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This is a declared narrowing: the full suite held the lock for 9m05s, too close to the 10-minute foreground cap to repeat.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail run type-check` (echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. It ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...'` (`Tasks:    11 successful, 11 total`). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the changed test file.
- eslint on the changed test file, with the package's own config and `--format json`: 1 file, 0 errors, 5 warnings (`@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`), identical to its base blob linted via `--stdin` (1 file, 0 errors, 5 warnings, same rule). Population: `--print-config` resolves a config for the file (119 rules). The config has no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so there is no type-aware linting and this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: before the changeset, exit 1: `1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change adds no changeset`. After it, exit 0: `this change declares 1 changeset(s)` … `Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter`.
- `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-pending-changeset-literals`: exit 0.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`: exit 0.
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths: `NOT GOVERNED`.
- Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the lint farm are CI's.

## Serial

PR objectui#10914 touches `DetailView.tsx` and `renderers/record-details.tsx` in this package. Neither is touched here. This branch changes exactly two paths, the test file above and the new `.changeset` file.

- Against its head, fetched into a named ref (`pull/10914/head`, `2b3d2061a`): `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` with that ref gives exit 0, clean tree `3f2b90a34`. Its file list, taken against its merge-base with `main`, has no path in common with this branch.
- Against a fresh `origin/main` (`733fd5ac6`, unchanged since the branch point): `git merge-tree --write-tree` gives exit 0, clean tree `6b2edc48c`.

## Acceptance notes

- The two windowed cases in this file keep their `settleObjectSchema` gate. Since objectui#10690 the windowed row fetch already waits on the settled schema, so that gate is now a second guard there. Left as it is: nothing is flaky there, and removing it is not this card.
- Withheld cells (the mask drawn while `objectTypesPending` holds) ride the same window as the stamp. The client-mode files that read cells do it inside `waitFor` or through an explicit hold, and the detector kept them green. They are outside the census class (no sort or filter control).
